SIDE LETTER

Spreeblick Growth Fund III SCSp (the "Fund")
Nordlicht Pensionskasse VVaG (the "Investor")

Dear Sirs,

In consideration of the Investor's subscription for a Commitment to the Fund, the General Partner agrees as follows.

1. Management Fee. The Management Fee payable in respect of the Investor's Commitment shall be reduced by 50 basis points per annum.

2. Excused Investments. The Investor shall be excused from participating in any Portfolio Investment in a company deriving more than 10% of its revenues from tobacco or thermal coal.

3. Drawdown Notices. The General Partner shall give the Investor not less than fifteen (15) Business Days' notice of each capital call.

4. Reporting. The General Partner shall provide the Investor with a quarterly ESG report on each Portfolio Company.

5. Most Favoured Nation. The Investor shall be entitled to elect the benefit of any rights granted to another investor with an equal or smaller Commitment, under the most favoured nation process.

6. Confidentiality. This letter is confidential and governed by the laws of Luxembourg.

Yours faithfully,
Spreeblick Capital GP S.à r.l.
